OFFICE/DIVISION: 
  Office of the Vice President for Research


POSITION TITLE: 
     Executive Officer to the Office of the Vice President for Research


POSITION NUMBER: 
 WPUEXPROO2


POSITION CLASSIFICATION:
  Executive Management


JOB LOCATION:
  Western Pacific University, Ialibu, SHP, PNG


ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIP:


Reports to: 
  Vice President for Research


Supervises: 
 None


Coordinates with:
  Vice Presidents, Administrative and Finance Divisions, Director of Sciences Research Department, Director of Social Sciences Research Department, Director of Contract & Consultation Research Department, and Director of Faculty Research Department.


JOB PURPOSE:


The Executive Officer to the Office of the Vice President for Research provides executive support to the Vice President for Research, ensuring that she/he is fully briefed in advance of meetings, following up on all agreed actions, representing her/his views where appropriate and undertaking specific actions and projects on her/his behalf. The Executive Officer to the Office of the Vice President for Research also has overall responsibility to assist the Vice President for Research to oversee the policies governing the conduct of research at the Western Pacific University and the management of its research programmes. The Executive Officer assists the Vice President for Research to seek external funding to promote interdisciplinary research. It also works to promote an institutional environment that sustains the high quality of the University's research programmes, while ensuring that research is conducted in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and University policies.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Job functions are specific duties that would be included in the essential functions of the job description. These functions are not all-inclusive nor do they cover the full extent of the duties performed.


1. Plans and prepares for meetings on behalf of the Vice President for Research, setting agendas, coordinating/preparing briefings, preparing presentations and attending meetings as appropriate.
2. Attends and takes minutes and action notes at meetings and deals with any follow up action.
3. Provides strategic counsel to the Vice President for Research and the executive team on policy and legislative issues at the University and State levels.
4. Supports specific initiatives, activities, projects and research commissioned by the Vice President for Research.
5. Coordinates a programme of internal and external communications on behalf of the Vice President for Research, including employee forums and other staff briefings, employee conferences, blogs, briefings and newsletters.
6. Pursues opportunities to engage external stakeholders and policy influencers in the WPU's advocacy efforts to promote quality of research; cultivates and maintains strategic relationships among key policy makers and government leaders and represents the Research Division to major stakeholders, including elected officials and their staff, non-profit organizations and other partners.
7. Works collaboratively with WPU's academics and research programmes to facilitate sharing of external research to shape internal programming and policy, reviewing internal knowledge and experiences to shape thought leadership and external policy.
8. Assists the Vice President for Research and the executive team with landscape and SWOT analyses to help recognize opportunities and threats to the Research Division.
9. Assists the Vice President for Research and the executive team with projects and activities that help the Research Division pursue organization-wide funding, investments, opportunities and initiatives.
10. Assists the Vice President for Research and the executive team in developing and executing strategy for accomplishing the Research Division's short- and long-term organizational goals.
11. Represents the views of the Vice President for Research when authorized and appropriate.
12. Undertakes any other reasonable duties as may be required commensurate with the level of the post.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


a. Master's Degree or equivalent.
b. Understanding of local and national Government and the public sector more widely, its constraints and opportunities, and its changing environment.
c. Experience of researching complex issues, writing reports, and preparing comprehensive briefings, notes and action plans.
d. Experience of managing a complex workload, preparing plans and meeting deadlines and milestones.
e. Experience of working in a politically-led organization and understanding of the political decision-making process.
f. Experience of working in partnership to identify best practice and deliver positive outcomes.
g. Experience of using project management approaches and principles.
h. Experience of preparing policy papers, with clear analysis of implications.
i. Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to adapt style, tone and method for different audiences.
j. Research, information gathering, minute taking and writing skills for reports and briefings.
k. Political sensitivity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion, tact, diplomacy, confidentiality and judgement on issues of significance and importance, and when dealing with politicians and officials at the highest levels.
l. Ability to demonstrate political neutrality at all times.
m. Ability to plan, spot and pre-empt issues, opportunities and priorities on behalf of the Vice President for Research and wider leadership team.
n. Ability to analyze, interpret and summarise policies.
o. Advanced ICT skills including in the preparation of presentation materials.
p. Experience of producing work of a high standard with a high level of attention to detail.
q. Self-starter with a positive 'can-do' attitude and ability to take the initiative.

28696.description:
OFFICE/DIVISION: 
      Office of the Vice President, Academic Affairs


POSITION TITLE: 
        Director, Quality Assurance


POSITION NUMBER:
     WPUQA001


POSITION CLASSIFICATION:
   Academic


JOB LOCATION: 
         Ialibu, Western Pacific University


ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIP:


Accountable to: 
      Vice President, Academic Affairs


Reports to: 
             Vice President, Academic Affairs


Coordinates with: 
   Faculty’s Deans, Heads of Departments and Registrar


Supervises: 
            Quality Assurance Officers; Institutional Research and Planning Staff; Administrative Support Staff


JOB PURPOSE:


The Director, Quality Assurance provides strategic leadership over the University's quality assurance framework, ensuring academic, research, administrative, and support services meet institutional standards, stakeholder expectations, accreditation requirements, and national/international quality benchmarks; working closely with academic and administrative leaders, the role sets quality strategy, policies, systems, and performance monitoring processes to build a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, while driving quality enhancement initiatives, managing quality-related risk, promoting evidence-based decision-making, supporting accreditation and regulatory compliance, and reducing inefficiencies to strengthen the University's delivery of high-quality education, research, and outcomes for stakeholders.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Strategic Leadership and Quality Management


1. Develop, implement, and oversee the University's Quality Assurance Framework, policies, procedures, and strategic quality roadmap.
2. Lead institutional quality initiatives aligned with the University's Strategic Plan and national higher education standards.
3. Establish and monitor quality performance indicators (KPIs) for academic and administrative units, including accreditation status, audit outcomes, stakeholder satisfaction, policy compliance, and quality improvement targets.
4. Promote a culture of quality, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement throughout the University.
5. Advise the Vice-Chancellor, Executive Management, Senate, and Council on quality assurance matters, emerging trends, and best practices in higher education.
6. Lead, mentor, and manage the Quality Assurance Directorate, including staff development, performance management, and succession planning.


Quality Management Systems, Accreditation and Compliance


1. Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the University's Quality Management System (QMS).
2. Coordinate institutional accreditation, program accreditation, review, and re-accreditation processes.
3. Ensure compliance with requirements of national regulatory agencies, professional accreditation bodies, and institutional policies.
4. Serve as the University's principal liaison with accreditation agencies, regulatory authorities, professional bodies, and external quality auditors.
5. Lead internal and external quality audits and ensure successful audit outcomes.
6. Develop and oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes to address audit findings, compliance issues, and quality risks.
7. Monitor regulatory developments and recommend institutional responses to maintain compliance.


Academic Quality Assurance


1. Oversee the approval, review, monitoring, and improvement of academic programs.
2. Ensure academic standards, curriculum quality, assessment practices, and learning outcomes meet institutional and regulatory requirements.
3. Coordinate academic audits, peer reviews, and quality evaluations across faculties and academic departments.
4. Support faculties and departments in implementing quality enhancement initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
5. Promote quality-by-design principles in curriculum development and program delivery.
6. Monitor student success indicators, graduate outcomes, and academic performance measures.


Institutional Effectiveness and Performance Monitoring


1. Develop institutional quality metrics and performance dashboards.
2. Analyze institutional data to assess effectiveness, efficiency, student outcomes, and operational performance.
3. Conduct benchmarking exercises against national and international higher education standards and best practices.
4. Prepare quality assurance reports, institutional performance reports, and quality scorecards for management and governance bodies.
5. Monitor implementation of quality improvement initiatives and measure their effectiveness.


Internal Quality Audits and Continuous Improvement


1. Develop and implement an annual internal quality audit programme covering academic, administrative, and support units.
2. Coordinate reviews of faculties, departments, centres, and administrative units.
3. Investigate quality concerns, audit findings, complaints, non-conformances, and performance gaps.
4. Lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
5. Monitor implementation of audit recommendations and quality improvement plans.
6. Ensure timely follow-up, evaluation, and reporting of improvement actions.
Policy Development, Risk Management and Governance
1. Develop, review, and update quality assurance policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
2. Identify institutional quality-related risks and recommend mitigation measures.
3. Collaborate with Risk Management, Legal, and Compliance functions on governance, regulatory compliance, and institutional risk matters.
4. Support quality readiness reviews for new academic programs, campuses, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.
5. Ensure quality management systems remain effective, relevant, and aligned with institutional objectives.


Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Focus


1. Engage students, staff, alumni, employers, industry partners, and external stakeholders on quality matters.
2. Coordinate student evaluations, graduate surveys, employer feedback, and stakeholder satisfaction assessments.
3. Manage stakeholder complaints relating to service quality and academic quality.
4. Facilitate quality improvement initiatives informed by stakeholder feedback and data analysis.
5. Represent the University on quality assurance forums, networks, and professional bodies.


Training, Capacity Building and Quality Culture


1. Develop and implement training programmes on quality assurance principles, accreditation requirements, assessment practices, and continuous improvement.
2. Build institutional capacity in quality management, data-driven decision-making, and compliance.
3. Provide technical guidance and support to faculties, departments, and administrative units on quality matters.
4. Foster awareness of quality standards and promote a culture of excellence across the University.
Reporting, Documentation and Communication
1. Prepare annual quality assurance reports, accreditation reports, audit reports, and institutional effectiveness reports.
2. Maintain accurate quality assurance records, databases, and documentation.
3. Present quality reports, findings, and recommendations to Executive Management, Senate, Academic Board, Council Committees, and external stakeholders.
4. Communicate quality performance outcomes and improvement initiatives throughout the University.
5. Ensure data integrity and evidence-based reporting for institutional decision-making.
Budget and Resource Management
1. Prepare and manage the Quality Assurance Directorate budget.
2. Ensure effective allocation of resources for quality initiatives, audits, accreditation activities, training, and quality management systems.
3. Evaluate and implement quality assurance technologies, data management systems, and process automation tools.
4. Ensure efficient utilization of staff, financial resources, and quality-related infrastructure.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


a. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Life Sciences, or related field (Master's often preferred).
b. 8–12+ years of progressive quality assurance/quality management experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role.
c. Deep knowledge of quality frameworks relevant to the industry (ISO, Six Sigma, Lean, GMP, etc.).
d. Certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM), Six Sigma Black Belt, or industry-specific credentials (strongly preferred).
e. Proven experience leading audits and managing regulatory relationships.
f. Strong analytical, statistical, and root-cause analysis skills.
g. Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence skills.


 


How to Apply


If then interested, all candidates must send their Expression of Interest, CV, and relevant documents to

OFFICE/DIVISION:        
Western Pacific University’s Office of the Vice President, University Advancement.


POSITION TITLE:           
Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology


POSITION NUMBER:      
WPUICT001


JOB LOCATION:              
Ialibu, Western Pacific University


SALARY LEVEL:             
 N14


ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIP:


Reports to:
     Vice President University Advancement


Supervises: 
  ICT Infrastructure Manager, Information Security Manager, the Information Administration and Communication Technology Manager, Students and Staff Support Services Manager, Cloud and Platform/s Manager and Data Management and Reporting Manager.


Coordinates with:
   Vice Presidents, Deans of Faculty, Directors, Bursar, Chief e-Librarian, Heads of Department.


JOB PURPOSE:


The Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology is an innovative, creative and dynamic leader charged with developing and implementing a strategic vision in all areas of technology for the University. Oversees best practices involving digital tools and integration of technology into daily practical classroom use and research. She/he needs to be a big picture thinker and a hands-on implementer, the Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology engages with administrators, educators and support personnel, parents and students to extend responsible and creative use of technology.
The Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology must be a strategic thinker with strong communication, organization, and interpersonal skills, and the enthusiasm and credibility to create and sustain instructional momentum in the appropriate use of technology in the WPU’s curriculum and instruction. The Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology oversees staff development opportunities to meet the diverse learning needs of staff as it relates to integrating technology into academic programming.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1. The Director of ICT Innovation and Academic Technology is responsible for planning, implementing, directing and maintaining the WPU's use of educational and research technology within the instructional curriculum.
2. Evaluating and providing recommendations regarding complementing classroom instruction with software applications and computer technology.
3. Assisting administrators and lecturers, providing professional development for educational technology and overseeing the WPU’s Online Learning Plan.
4. Communicates with parents, students, employees, administrators and outside the University for the purpose of providing administrative support, enhancing program awareness and assisting with program implementation and conflict resolution.
5. Collaborates and coordinates the design, planning, support, professional development and implementation of technology use in teaching, learning, research and WPU curriculum for the purpose of improving student learning experience in all subject areas.
6. Develops and directs the development and interpretation of program policy and procedures for the purpose of establishing guidelines needed to effectively and efficiently meet WPU educational program goals while adhering to all relevant regulations and guidelines.
7. Collaborates with the Director of Project and Infrastructure Development and the WPU Cabinet to develop, evaluate, and implement technology plans and assists in the creation and management of the Online Learning.
8. Manages personnel who are available to meet program, WPU needs and objectives.
9. Directs program assessments for the purpose of ensuring that technology standards for lecturers and students meet program goals and WPU academic guidelines.
10. Directs, analyses and evaluates a variety of program related data (e.g. student assessments, lecturers’ assessments, emerging technology trends, requested applications, systems and hardware, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring availability of technology resources needed to meet student, and staff objectives while adhering to budget limitations.
11. Identifies, develops and reports program related technology assessment results for the purpose of directing student and lecturer’s growth toward technology integration, technology literacy and technology use.
12. Participates in meetings, workshops and seminars for the purpose of conveying and/or gathering information required to perform functions and/or representing the University to external individuals and/or organizations.
13. Prepares a variety of materials (e.g. presentations, reports, memos, letters, procedures, manuals, assessments, etc.) for the purpose of documenting activities, providing written reference, and/or conveying information.
14. Responds to inquiries for the purpose of providing information and/or direction.
15. Performs other tasks and assumes other responsibilities as assigned.
16. Knowledge of privacy laws and digital literacy for staff and students.
17. Create online learning and all facets thereof; laws, programs, set-up, professional development, scope of instruction.
18. Knowledge of current instructional practices, principles and techniques of instructional technology.
19. Principles and techniques for project planning, scheduling and control, public sector business practices and emerging trends in instructional technology. Use of technology to support instruction in all Facilities curriculum content areas.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


a. Master’s Degree in Information Technology or other teaching qualification.
b. Evidence of relevant and challenging continuing professional development.
c. Knowledge and experience in ICT.
d. Experience in leading the vision, strategic planning and implementation of Educational Technology and Innovation initiatives.
e. Experience in highly effective relationship management with a variety of stakeholders.
f. Record of excellent personal success as a classroom lecturer and a passion for own academic subject.
g. Experience of developing and implementing digital projects in an educational environment.
h. Successful experience implementing various technologies in instructional and classroom settings.
i. Experience in providing professional development and/or recent mentoring and/or support experience.
j. Must be able to collaborate and cooperate with other departments.
k. A minimum of three (3) years of experience in Higher Education.
l. Have the ability and willingness to inspire others; leading by example, role modeling the WPU’s vision statement: Education for Life and Leadership.
m. Be flexible and capable of managing change and instilling high standards.
n. Be highly motivated, ambitious and collaborative and willing to take the initiative.
o. Have high levels of honesty and integrity in aspects of their role.
p. Demonstrate empathy, humility and genuine care about staff and students, taking time to support, guide and motivate them.
q. Be able to think strategically and drive improvements in student welfare and their wider learning experiences.
r. Be flexible and able to manage change.
s. Have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills.
t. Demonstrate strategic leadership and the ability to lead and manage a team to deliver the digitalized WPU development plan effectively.

                      Coordinating Officer, Researchers, Research Technical Staff

             Director of Sciences Research Department, Director of Contract & Consultation Research Department, and Director of Faculty Research.


JOB PURPOSE:


Director of Social Sciences Department is an administrator of the Department. He/she will do Social Researcher work on behalf of the Social Sciences Department to design, formulate, implement and manage social science research projects. These involve exploring sociological theories by designing and carrying out surveys, interviews and focus groups. The results of these projects are used by companies, governments and various authorities to gather the opinions of populations and present statistical evidence for or against particular issues of political or commercial significance. The work carried out by social researchers within the department can play a vital role in the democratic process, as well as in the management and actions of major organizations. The research helps to form opinions and shape policy and legislation.


ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Job functions are specific duties that would be included in the essential functions of the job description. These functions are not all-inclusive nor do they cover the full extent of the duties performed.


1. Develop and establish a social scientific strategy and implementation plan for the key areas of responsibility within the department which is subject to annual review and reporting.
2. Establish and promote standards of practice and quality across the whole of Social Sciences Department.
3. Provide scientific advice on academic standards for higher education and training for the broader development of the workforce including leadership opportunities.
4. Advise the Academic Board and University Council through the Office of the Vice President Research on the scientific implications of decisions on strategy and the WPU’s research plan.
5. Explore opportunities for attracting research and other sponsorship funding to support the furtherance of the aims and objectives of the research culture at WPU.
6. Develop and maintain effective social science networks.
7. Assist researchers in a variety of research methods (including qualitative and quantitative sampling), which they must be able to employ professionally, with painstaking attention and complete impartiality.
8. Taking a brief and using appropriate and creative methodologies to design research projects using qualitative and quantitative methods.
9. Tendering for research contracts.
10. Carrying out or directing fieldwork to gather information.
11. Preparing and reporting findings.
12. Using ICT skills to present data.
13. Disseminating results, both orally and in writing.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


a. Postgraduate study, minimum Master’s degrees, preferable PhD or other relevant degree with subjects: Economics, Psychology, Social Studies, Social Sciences, Sociology, Statistics.
b. Must be familiar with research methods and statistical techniques.
c. An interest in social developments, trends and attitudes.
d. An investigative and analytical mind.
e. A thorough methodical approach to work.
f. Good communication and interpersonal skills to gather information from people.
g. Ability to explain findings clearly, both verbally and in written reports.
h. Excellent IT skills to produce statistics, graphs and models.
i. Ability to work to deadlines.
j. Meticulous planning skills and self-motivation.

28145.description:
PNG Air, renowned for its extensive network covering over 26 destinations throughout Papua New Guinea, operates the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 & ATR 42-600 series aircraft in the region. As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.


 


Trainer – PSS & DCS


 


PNG Air is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced 
Trainer – PSS & DCS 
to join its Commercial Department based in Port Moresby.


 


The Trainer delivers training on both the Passenger Service System (PSS) and Departure Control System (DCS) to new and existing PNG Air staff across the network, as a multi-skilled trainer covering both systems rather than a single specialization.


The role supports the Head of Trainers in keeping training delivery consistent, high quality, and aligned with the department's documented processes and standards.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Training Delivery




Deliver classroom, on-the-job and/or e-learning training on PSS and DCS to new and existing staff.


Tailor delivery to different audiences (e.g. reservations, check-in, airport operations) while maintaining consistent core content.


Travel to network stations as required to deliver training on site.




Assessment & Certification Support




Administer competency assessments and practical evaluations for trainees.


Track individual trainee progress and provide feedback to trainees and the Head of Trainers.


Support the certification process by ensuring assessment results are recorded accurately and promptly.




Content Support




Assist the Head of Trainers in reviewing and updating training materials, manuals and e-learning content for PSS and DCS.


Provide feedback on the clarity and accuracy of the Process and Policy Manual and training materials based on delivery experience.




Records & Reporting




Maintain accurate attendance, assessment and certification records for each training session.


Report training outcomes, issues or trends to the Head of Trainers.




Continuous Improvement




Identify recurring knowledge gaps or common errors observed during training and feed these back to the Head of Trainers.


Liaise with the Helpdesk team where trends in support tickets point to a training need.




 


QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCES


 


Essential




Certificate or Diploma in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.


Minimum one to two years' experience working with airline PSS and/or DCS systems.


Prior experience delivering training, coaching or on-the-job instruction.


Good verbal and written communication and presentation skills.




Desirable




Formal training/facilitation qualification.


Experience within the aviation industry across multiple functions (reservations, check-in, airport operations).


Experience developing training or e-learning content.




 


 


 


If you feel you meet our requirements and are interested, we would like to hear from you. Send your application in only one PDF file to:


 


[email protected]


 


Applications close: 
Friday 23rd October 2026


Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


 


We are an equal opportunity employer.

28808.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


Purpose
As the 
Supervisor, Engineering Services
, you will lead a multi-disciplinary Engineering Services team, providing critical support to site operations through safe, practical, and cost-effective engineering solutions. In this leadership role, you will drive the delivery of fit-for-purpose designs, technical drawings, specification updates, operational readiness initiatives, and continuous improvement projects that enhance reliability, safety, and performance.


Working closely with operational and maintenance stakeholders, you will ensure engineering services are delivered efficiently and to a high standard, enabling the business to achieve its production and operational objectives while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and value.


Essential Duties




Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary Engineering Services team, providing technical support and engineering solutions that enable safe, reliable, and efficient site operations.


Plan, prioritise and coordinate team workloads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality engineering designs, technical services, and project outcomes.


Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering practices, enhance asset integrity, and reduce lifecycle costs across the operation.


Oversee the delivery of mechanical, electrical and civil design projects, from concept through to implementation, ensuring robust review processes and engineering excellence.


Manage the execution of OPEX projects, delivering safe, fit-for-purpose solutions on schedule and within budget.


Ensure the application and continuous improvement of engineering standards, maintaining compliance with PNG regulatory requirements and relevant Australian Standards.


Support and contribute to CAPEX projects, working closely with stakeholders to provide engineering expertise throughout the project lifecycle.


Monitor industry and regulatory developments, ensuring site systems, standards and engineering practices remain current and effective.


Champion document control and engineering governance, ensuring accurate design documentation, specifications, approvals, and record management.


Lead and influence change through the Management of Change (MOC) process, ensuring risks are identified and managed effectively.


Coach, mentor and develop engineers, designers, graduates and emerging talent, building technical capability across the broader engineering team.


Foster strong cross-functional relationships, collaborating with operations, maintenance, projects and business support teams to achieve shared goals.




Training & Experience




A bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering, or related fields


Significant demonstrated experience in mining or heavy industries


Registered IEPNG members advantageous


Proven experience leading design management and major project delivery, with a track record of successfully developing and executing complex engineering solutions


Strong knowledge of engineering design systems and software, with the ability to provide leadership across multiple disciplines


Extensive experience within large-scale processing plants or similar heavy industrial environments, bringing practical expertise to complex operational challenges


Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, delivering reliable engineering support to critical fixed plant assets


Hands-on understanding of complex processing facilities and supporting infrastructure, enabling practical and effective decision-making


Exceptional planning, prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing demands and deliver results


Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, coupled with a keen eye for detail and commitment to quality outcomes


Ability to work autonomously while fostering a positive, collaborative and high-performance team culture


Results-driven and technically focused, with a systematic approach to engineering design and a passion for delivering safe, efficient and fit-for-purpose solutions


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively




Working Conditions


This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.


At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.​

28572.description:
POSITION:
Lecturer - Balimo College School of Nursing


PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS JOB DESCRIPTION POSITION IS FOR A LECTURER TO BE BASED IN BALIMO COLLEGE CAMPUS IN WESTERN PROVINCE, PNG. 


 


 ORGANISATION: 
Balimo College  


 POSITION:
Lecturer - Balimo College School of Nursing


 LOCATION:
Balimo, Western Province  


 REPORTING TO: 
Principal, Balimo College School of Nursing


 COMMENCING: 
January 2027


 


ABOUT BALIMO COLLEGE:


Balimo College is Western Province’s newest Higher Education Institute. In 2025, Balimo College opened the new School of Nursing and commenced a 4-year Bachelor of General Nursing program. The College’s vision is to advance Western Province by providing high-quality education, research and community engagement. The institute will foster pathways for teachers and nurses who are committed to improving access to vital services in Western Province.


Balimo College is a safe and supportive place for graduates and other professionals across the Western Province catchment region to return for life-long learning and ongoing professional development. The College will develop a community of education and health professionals committed to innovation, excellence and community advancement; by being the training College of choice for Papua New Guineans.


 


Balimo College is a PNG Sustainable Development Program (SDP) initiative delivered in partnership with KTF, Divine Word University, and Western Sydney University. Balimo College School of Nursing is an affiliate of Divine Word University.


 


ABOUT THE ROLE:


The Balimo College School of Nursing Lecturer is responsible for supporting the Principal of the College to uphold the College’s Vision, Mission, Core Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals. The Lecturer will operate within the Balimo College School of Nursing leadership structure as determined by the Principal, Balimo School of Nursing to disseminate strong, effective educational leadership, and manage all information technology within the parameters identified in this position description.


The Lecturer will have an in-depth knowledge of the ethos and purpose of the Balimo College School of Nursing and the principles by which it operates. The Lecturer will have a firm understanding of the Western Province health context and the objectives of Balimo College School of Nursing to create pathways for rural communities into the field of nursing.


 


KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
 
Applicants must demonstrate that they are able to meet the following Key Selection Criteria:  




Master’s Level Health qualification.


Bachelor’s degree in nursing.


Education qualification is preferred.


Minimum 3 years of teaching experience.


Knowledge of a range of educational theories, techniques, and methodologies of personnel and management and a strong interest in current educational and technological trends.


Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.


Be willing to relocate to Balimo College campus.


Applicants must have the right to work in




 


Knowledge of:




PNG Nursing Council Standards.


Bachelor of Nursing Curriculum.


Principles and practices of administration and supervision.


DHERST requirements for a School of Nursing.




 


Ability to:




Provide leadership, direction and motivation to students.


Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with staff and students. 


Interpret, apply, and explain rules, regulations, policies and procedures to students and parents. 


Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others. 


Operate a computer to a good level of competence.


Analyse situations accurately in a classroom context and support an effective course of actions. 


Organise and keep to the schedule and timelines for the academic delivery of curriculum, mentoring and assessments. 


Plan, organise and prioritize work.




 


Personal Skills & Attributes:




Strong health education background.


Proven ability to work within a team.


Strong sense of justice.


Care for young people.


Intellectual capacity with a strong interest in current educational trends.


Relational style which commands loyalty.


Problem solving ability and multi-tasking capability.


Ability to confront difficult situations.


Resilience and energy.




 


RESPONSIBILITIES:


The Lecturer is responsible for:




Supporting the Principal in establishing and upholding a management vision for the Balimo College School of Nursing.


Exercising discernment and care in assisting the Principal and teaching team with supporting staff students, and parents.


Supporting the development and empowerment of the teaching staff that will cultivate and strengthen a positive teaching, learning, and working environment for all staff and students at every level of operations. 


Supporting the Principal with operational logistics for Balimo College School of Nursing and ensure the smooth day-to-day operations of the College.




 


Vision, Mission and Culture




Uphold and lead others to the realisation of the Mission, Vision, Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals of the Balimo College School of Nursing in all operations.


Be able to hold a vision for the College and lead others to the realisation of that


Support the establishment of a School of Nursing culture that will characterise the School as a place of care, academic excellence, transparency and integrity, accountability, and commitment to community.


Establish a strong collaborative service culture within the School of Nursing and local




 


Administration




Be familiar with College administration procedures and effect efficient practices in liaison with the administration staff.


Support the Principal with sourcing quotes and receiving payment receipts in a timely manner for the smooth running of the college.


Attend all Professional Development meetings, attend termly staff meetings and record details if required by the principal for wider circulation to staff.


Be familiar with the Balimo College School of Nursing calendar and attend all calendared meetings and lectures in a timely manner.


Ensure personal full compliance of the College rules and behavioural expectations for yourself and your students.


Delivery of the curriculum.


Monitor and record student’s information clearly, coherently and confidentially for the identification and conducting of learner assessments.


Alert the Principal to any maintenance requirements or any issues of Occupational Health and Safety Policy and Procedures on site.




 


Teaching & Learning




Actively and pro-actively enhance the quality of teaching and learning.


Analyse and evaluate available data on student performance and take appropriate action to improve teaching and learning outcomes.


Promote the use of ICT and of developments in Digital Learning Technologies and actively support the students to enable their studies with the support of ICT


Support the Principal with the delivery and moderation of assessment and reporting across whole staff cohort.


Support the Principal with the delivery and management of the practicum component of the curriculum.


Manage a personal teaching load within specialism.




 


Student Enrolment and Welfare




Support the Principal with the interview process of prospective students and their families (where appropriate) for enrolment suitability according to the Balimo College School of Nursing Enrolment Policy.


Support the Principal (where appropriate) with the decision making around the chosen candidates for offer of placements at the College according to the Balimo College School of Nursing Enrolment Policy.


Liaise with parents/families (where appropriate) regarding enrolment of students with special needs and ongoing well-being of the students.




 


Professional Development




Regularly maintain on Professional Development Training to keep abreast of current trends in nursing education;


Attend and be actively engaged in appropriate Professional Development and facilitate staff attendance at professional development activities;


Keep up to date with current educational thought and practice;


Support the Principal to implement the Balimo College School of Nursing Professional Learning and Development Policy where it aligns to your specialism.




 


Financial Management




Support the Principal in providing input to the budget of the School of Nursing.




Email application to: 
[email protected]


 


Balimo College of Nursing is a child safe organisation committed to the protection of people we serve. Our recruitment and selection procedures are designed to ensure we only recruit people who are suitable and aligned with our policies that ensure the safety of children and protection of all from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. All appointments are subject to appropriate background checks and screening, and the successful candidate will be required to get a Working with Children check and/or a Police Certificate. We promote diversity and equality in all our practices and strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds and/or disabilities to apply for positions with Balimo College School of Nursing.

26991.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


Joining our growing exploration team as our drilling program expands in 2026 and 2027, you will provide front line leadership, support, mentoring and service in all geology activities, associated with exploration and resource drilling, core processing, sample analysis and resource evaluation. Observe and adhere to the workplace health & safety policies to ensure safety of employee’s contractors and stakeholders.


Key Accountabilities


Key accountabilities of this position include.




Provide appropriate leadership, guidance mentoring and support in geology services to exploration.


Manage all Exploration sampling activities – including but not limited to drilling, rock chip, soil sampling.


Surveying and mapping designated areas / prospects.


Analysing geological data using specialist computer applications.


Preparing reports, both internal and statutory, physicals and forecast. Complete all reports in a timely manner, adhering to strict deadlines.


Ensure correct QA/QC protocols are adhered to.


Drill hole planning, designs and roll out.


Ensuring / authorising that geotechnical inspections of drill pads are completed, pre- and post-construction and pre-drilling. Ensure that regular monitoring of drill pads is carried out.


Coordinate drill pads design and construction in a timely manner.


Ensure logging of core by geologist is accurate, consistent, and complete; includes inspecting core logs and comparing with drill core.


Carry out weekly database checks to ensure logging is complete and following up where incomplete.


Maintain accuracy at all times of processing data collected by core shed technicians and data base assistants (core mark-up, recovery, RQD, magnetic susceptibility, ASD, XRF, core photography, cutting and sampling).


Ensure that Camp Managers send core photos, timesheets, and daily reports daily.


Establish a high-performance culture by motivating team members to achieve a high level of performance and by rewarding and recognising high performance.


Ensure effective processes are in place for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members.


Direct and train employees on the Exploration SOP.


Continuously mentor and coach geology technicians on effective sampling, core processing techniques.


Actively review the work performance of geology and technicians and provide feedback to the Vice President (Exploration and Deputy Exploration including the talent and succession planning for designated key roles.


Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.


Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.


Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.


Ensure exploration drilling and sampling is conducted by competent technicians in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.




About You 


To be considered for this position, it is essential that applicants have the following




Bachelor`s Degree in Geology (Preferable), Geophysics or Geoscience


7+ years relevant mining or exploration work experience essential.


Computer proficiency in MS Office suite and the ability to analyse numerical and graphical data, including experience with 3D modelling software.


Experience in the use of Pronto will be advantageous.


Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.


Excellent trouble-shooting skills.


Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.


Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.


Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

28838.description:
Media Metro is the leading Outdoor Advertising Billboard company across Papua New Guinea. With an ever growing network and new sites coming online regularly, we are fast growth business and we seek a new team member to join our sales and marketing team.  


The core role of “Sales and Admin Executive” is based from our office location in Gordon, Port Moresby and the core role includes;


Sales and Production Support Admin




Assisting the team with prepping sales and production quotes and simple presentations documents using work and excel relating to our advertiser proposals.


Attending both sales and production meetings with our sales team and advertisers to ensure we deliver the requirements of our advertisers, taking meeting notes and liaising with our suppliers as required. 


Following up advertisers for their signed advertising agreements, supporting the sales team while also ensuring our sales and site network records are accurate and up to date.


Using one of the company motor vehicles on a weekly basis to take site photos of advertising campaigns that have been installed and sharing the photos with the sales team and advertisers




Website and Social Media Marketing




Working with the MD and the PNG sales team to set up and develop on our marketing platforms including our website billboard images as well as creating and uploading our facebook and Instagram marketing strategy.




Office, Admin and Database Mgmt Tasks




Reviewing and constantly maintaining our admin systems, photo libraries, billboard network lists, advertising expiry reports and our business contacts and databases.


Managing our petty cash including recording usage via our spreadsheet, distribution of petty cash funds to the team and replenishing topping up these funds as required as well as collating and managing our monthly summary works


Managing the fleet of vehicles for the requirements of monitoring and managing their annual servicing, repairs, and registration tasks and filing such documents.


Ensuring the office is well maintained including stationery, printer inks and all associated office supplies, and liaising with NZ for such products as required.


Maintaining our filing systems both in soft copy and hard copy formats.




End of Month Management - Monthly




Managing the company “End of Month” sales processes which require collating excel spreadsheets, cross referencing our sales and production invoices and the required communication with the team in New Zealand.


This job task is a very significant part of this role and is ongoing month by month. It requires excellent communication skills, excellent knowledge of excel and “knowing you numbers”; a strong level of accuracy; and attention to detail is also critical to the success of this task.




Key Requirements of the Candidate and Your Experience




In this role, an excellent knowledge and experience in working with Microsoft Excel is very important as many of the duties require excel and spreadsheeting of our sales and admin reporting.


You will have worked previously within both sales team environments including direct sales support and or admin roles over the past 5 years.


You are looking to grow and develop your career in a fast moving and fast growing business – we seek a dynamic and curious individual, eager to learn.


You will be skilled and knowledgeable with the common social media platforms and be able to demonstrate the same skill and knowledge through your recent experience and use of social media.


A full drivers Licence with at least 2 years prior experience in driving


You may have worked within other advertising or media selling businesses, or you may have worked within sales and marketing teams in prior work you’ve done




Attitude, Work Ethic and Training




We seek a positive hard working individual who is well educated with tertiary level qualifications and someone that is motivated and driven to grow and develop their career.


You will be required to work autonomously, set plans, be proactive, engage with clients and suppliers, and prioritize your daily activities, in consultation with the NZ based MD and the Port Moresby based Management team.


Our business rewards excellence; we provide full training and support; and we will monitor and support all our team with individual performance goals.




Remuneration and Future Growth




We will pay the successful candidate a combination of excellent above market value salary, bonuses for exceptional performance, superannuation and you will join our company medical insurance plan.


We expect our team members to growth with our business, therefore future opportunities will be very likely for top performers




 


Important: It is an explicit requirement of this role that the candidate must have a full drivers licence to enable sales support tasks to be completed in an efficient and effective manner.


You must have past experience in sales and marketing type settings, and while not crictical, past experience in advertising or media would be also valuable.


If you are vibrant, motivated, well educated and thinking that this sounds like a role perfect for your skills and experience, then please send a brief cover letter and your CV to 
[email protected]

28789.description:
Islands Petroleum 
is an independently owned fuel and lubes distributor, and the exclusive distributor for Mobil Lubricants in Papua New Guinea. Islands Petroleum operates bulk fuel and lubricant Depots and Distribution Centres in the Islands, Momase, Southern, and the Highlands regions. Our national head office is based in Kokopo.


We are currently seeking to hire an experienced 
Safety Advisor 
to be based in Rabaul Office to oversee our safety operations within the New Guinea Islands region.


 


The Role & Responsibilities


Reporting to the OHSE & Training Coordinator, the Safety Advisor will play a key role in driving a strong safety culture, supporting compliance, reducing operational risk, and delivering training initiatives across the business.


 


Key responsibilities include:




Develop, implement, review, and continuously improve OHSE policies, procedures, programs, and workplace safety systems.


Prepare and present reports on safety performance, training activities, incidents, accidents, and compliance matters, including investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action recommendations.


Facilitate workplace risk management processes, including JSEA, Take 5, Safety Work Instructions, and other risk assessment tools.


Support Permit to Work (PTW) processes for high-risk activities, including confined space entry, hot work, working at heights, and electrical work.


Conduct workplace HSE inspections, audits, and compliance monitoring activities.


Coordinate incident trend analysis, corrective action plans, safety interventions, and Stop Work Authority processes to drive continuous improvement.


Support contractor safety management and monitor contractor compliance with company safety requirements.


Coordinate workplace injury rehabilitation and return-to-work programs.


Assist in the development, implementation, and testing of emergency response plans and emergency drills for depot, road transport, and marine operations.


Liaise with and report to relevant PNG regulatory authorities on OHSE and training matters.


Conduct training needs assessments and identify skills and knowledge gaps across the organization.


Facilitate Employee Health Awareness and Monitoring Programs


Design, develop, coordinate, and deliver annual training programs and learning initiatives.


Manage and maintain in-house training facilities and equipment.


Promote a culture focused on zero harm, environmental protection, and duty of care throughout the organization.




 


Candidate Requirements


The successful candidate must posses:




A tertiary qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health & Safety, Risk Management, or a related discipline.


Certificate IV in Occupational Health & Safety or equivalent.


Minimum 3-5 years' practical experience in an HSE Advisory, OHSE, or related role.


Strong knowledge of OHSE legislation, industry standards, compliance requirements, and best practices.


Demonstrated experience in incident investigation, root cause analysis, risk assessment, and corrective action management.


Experience facilitating workplace risk management tools such as JSEA, Take 5, SWI, and Permit to Work systems.


Experience in contractor management and emergency response preparedness.


Experience in developing, coordinating, and delivering workplace training programs.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organization.


Strong analytical, planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.


Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and report writing.


Experience within the petroleum, logistics, transport, industrial, or similar operational environment will be highly regarded.


East New Britain-based candidates are highly encouraged to apply.




Are you ready to champion safety and help our people perform at their best?


If you are passionate about workplace safety, capability development, and helping people work safely and effectively, we would like to hear from you.


Apply now for the position of Safety Advisor and help build the safety capability that supports Islands Petroleum's continued performance and growth.


 


Safety Advisor - RAB/NGI


 





    	        
Apply

28780.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


Purpose
As 
Planner, Shutdown
 you will play a key role in the success of critical Oxygen Plant shutdowns by coordinating detailed planning activities, optimising schedules and resources, and ensuring maintenance work is delivered safely, efficiently, and on time.


Essential Duties




Develop comprehensive shutdown plans, schedules, and readiness activities to ensure shutdowns are executed safely, efficiently, and on time. 


Utilise Newmont's SMSI shutdown readiness systems and processes to drive effective planning and execution outcomes. 


Partner closely with Maintenance, Operations, and key stakeholders to align shutdown scope, priorities, and resource requirements. 


Prepare and coordinate detailed shutdown work packs, documentation, and execution plans to support seamless delivery. 


Monitor shutdown progress, identify schedule risks, and implement adjustments to maintain critical milestones. 


Ensure all materials, tooling, equipment, and contractor resources are available, staged, and ready ahead of shutdown commencement. 


Manage shutdown parts, kits, and staging activities, ensuring all readiness requirements are met before execution. 


Lead shutdown risk assessments, implement mitigation strategies, and proactively monitor emerging risks throughout the shutdown lifecycle. 


Facilitate pre-shutdown planning meetings, readiness reviews, and shutdown charter approvals to ensure all stakeholders are aligned and prepared. 


Track, analyse, and report on shutdown performance metrics, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. 


Champion compliance with safety, environmental, and operational standards while promoting a strong safety culture across all shutdown activities.




Training & Experience




Proven experience in shutdown planning, maintenance coordination, or a similar heavy industry environment.


Strong understanding of statutory, safety, and environmental requirements, with a demonstrated commitment to compliance and risk management.


Broad knowledge of maintenance trades and how multiple disciplines interact during complex shutdown activities.


Advanced skills in shutdown planning, scheduling, and coordination, ensuring work is scoped, resourced, and executed safely and effectively.


Experience conducting risk assessments, identifying potential execution challenges, and implementing practical mitigation strategies.


Proficiency in Microsoft Project, including resource levelling, scheduling, and cost control methodologies.


Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines.


Significant practical experience as a maintenance tradesperson or within a maintenance-focused role.


Demonstrated frontline leadership experience, with the ability to influence, coordinate, and engage diverse teams and contractors.


Sound understanding of work scoping, planning processes, and maintenance execution best practices.


A trade qualification or equivalent industry experience is highly regarded.




Working Conditions
This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.


At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.​


Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont​
Hear from our people: Life at Newmont​


Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team: 
[email protected]
.

28778.description:
About Newmont


At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.


About Lihir


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.


We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


Purpose
The 
Mechanical Technician
 will execute safe and effective mechanical maintenance activities to support the reliability, integrity, and availability of fixed plant equipment across operational areas. Perform planned, breakdown, and corrective maintenance tasks in accordance with maintenance strategies, procedures, and work management processes to minimise downtime and support continuous plant operations. Contribute to defect identification, equipment improvement initiatives, and quality maintenance execution while maintaining compliance with safety, environmental, and operational standards.


Essential Duties




Conduct routine mechanical inspections across operational equipment and record findings to support proactive and planned maintenance activities.


Execute and assist with breakdown, corrective, and preventative maintenance tasks to restore equipment reliability and operational performance.


Perform maintenance activities in accordance with site safety standards, isolation procedures, statutory requirements, and company maintenance practices.


Support Rotable Refurbishments, Fixed Crane Maintenance, and Fixed Compressor Maintenance activities to ensure equipment availability and reliability targets are achieved.


Maintain accurate maintenance history and equipment records through effective documentation of repairs, inspections, adjustments, and component replacements within maintenance management systems.


Monitor equipment condition and performance trends, identifying defects, risks, and early signs of failure, escalating findings and recommendations to Supervisors for intervention planning.


Assist with calibration, testing, and commissioning activities to ensure equipment operates within required performance and operational standards.


Support spare parts and inventory management through tracking component usage and identifying critical spares requirements for maintenance activities.


Promote a strong safety culture by actively participating in safety interactions, toolbox meetings, hazard identification, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned to FRM objectives.




Training & Experience




Prior experience in fixed plant maintenance within heavy industry or mining environments, including Fixed Cranes and Compressor maintenance activities.


Proven experience maintaining and repairing fixed plant equipment including valves, gearbox drives, conveyor systems, pulleys, sprockets, pumps, feeder tracks, interstage screens, vibrating screens, fixed cranes, and compressors.


Relevant Mechanical Trade Certificate or Engineering Certificate essential, with PNG Driver’s Licence – Class 6 required.


Sound understanding of safe work procedures, lifting equipment operations, and site HSE requirements.


Competent in the use of maintenance tools, equipment, and maintenance management systems including SAP and Microsoft Office Suite.


Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capability with the ability to proactively resolve maintenance issues.


Effective verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to work across diverse cultural environments.


Strong interpersonal and active listening skills with the ability to work collaboratively within team environments.


Demonstrated ability to manage time effectively, adapt to operational changes, and support continuous improvement and waste reduction initiatives.


Works in accordance with PNG Mine Safety Act, Newmont Standards, Safety Policies and Procedures, Newmont Environment policies and all departmental operating procedures.


Skilled in the use of SAP sofware. 


Uses interpersonal negotiation skills and influencing skills to maintain the agreed breakdown work against weekly schedules. 


Demonstrated knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word and Excel.




Working Conditions
This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.


At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.


We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!





    	        
Apply
